name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: July Week 6 - Light and RGB
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: A sensor that changes value with light.
words.example: The photoresistor reading dropped when the sensor was covered.
The light sensor detected whether the desk was bright or dim.

words.definition: The sensor value limit that changes the RGB LED response.
words.example: The threshold decided when the warning LED turned on.
The room was dim, so the project changed color.
A bright flashlight made the sensor value rise.

words.definition: A sensor rule that compares a reading to a threshold before choosing a light color.
words.example: The condition checked whether the reading was above the threshold.

words.definition: Red, green, and blue colors used to make other colors.
words.example: The RGB LED mixed red and blue to make purple.

words.definition: A color made by combining other colors.
words.example: The color mix changed when the sensor detected more light.
